text_003: This policy explains what information this website collects and how it is used.
text_005: When you submit the contact form, your name, email, company, website, industry, budget, goal and message are saved in a private administrator inbox for up to 90 days so I can review and follow up. They are also sent through FormSubmit, a third-party form service, to younusshobon@gmail.com. You can email me directly instead. Your details are not sold or shared for marketing.
text_007: This website records page visits and CTA clicks using anonymous browser identifiers, including the page, button label, destination, traffic source, device type and approximate country. Analytics is kept for 90 days. Contact details are stored separately from anonymous analytics. Unsubmitted form fields and keystrokes are not collected. Administrator visits, common bots and browsers requesting Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control are excluded from anonymous tracking.
text_009: Some pages embed Google Maps, which is loaded from Google and subject to Google's privacy policy.
text_011: You can ask to access or delete information you've sent me by getting in touch through the contact page.
text_013: Questions about this policy can be sent via the contact page
